answer: Charge a sybil tax: every new agent pays $50, burned forever, and registers one cipher identity commitment — one tax, one cipher. A comet audit sweeps each epoch: a cipher seen twice, or a clone cluster, is ejected and loses its stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs $50,000 sunk, while an honest agent pays $50 once and earns in the oasis of verified peers, where repeat deals repay it many times over. Fakes pay full price; honest agents pay once.
